rule: ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claims 9 and 10: a DR1 judgement on the same difference, or a real cross-service constraint the prototype cannot express, overrides the prototype default; Rhys's 2026-08-28 DR1 judgement (document:dr1-parity-notes, ranked above every repo source) is exactly that judgement on where the dashboard lives, moving it out of the animals frontend to the INS frontend, and the prototype's own position (the lists live in the same service as the overall home, which is the INS frontend) points the same way.
outcome: The INS frontend hosts both category lists at /live-animals and /germinal-products, in the same service as the overall home as the prototype shows, reading the INS backend read model, which gains the facts, filters, search and sorts the list needs. This follows Rhys's DR1 judgement (2026-08-28) that the dashboard is temporary in the animals frontend and moves to the INS frontend, which the 2026-10-07 ruling lets override today's animals-frontend dashboard and which matches the animals backend's own note that its list endpoint is being replaced. The animals frontend's dashboard at its set root sends the trader to the INS frontend's live animals list; the animals backend's GET /notifications is left unchanged until nothing calls it. The home's Live animals 'View dashboard', the Action needed and Status updated drill-downs' Back links for live animals, and /dashboard with a query all go to that /live-animals list.
